clips.title: The story
paras: Zamah's Note carries an urgent plea from Thunder Bluff to Tarren Mill. Zamah asks Apothecary Lydon for an alchemical way to drive the Venture Company from Stonetalon without direct bloodshed.

The Venture Company has dug deep into the Stonetalon Mountains, felling trees and tearing up sacred land. Zamah wants a way to force the goblins out without slaughter. She turns to the Forsaken Royal Apothecary Society for help. Her note tells her colleague, Apothecary Lydon, about the danger in Stonetalon. Lydon is in Tarren Mill, far away in the Hillsbrad Foothills of Lordaeron.

The sealed note must cross continents to reach Lydon. Travelers from Kalimdor take a zeppelin to the Undercity, then travel south through Silverpine Forest into Hillsbrad. Lydon is intrigued by Zamah's specific request. Word has reached him from across the ocean, and he prepares an alchemical answer to the goblin problem.
